full_judgment: 2. Chena Bibi predecessor of the appellants as plaintiff instituted Partition Suit No. 33 of 1966 in the Court of Munsif, Comilla for partition of the suit land measuring 1.32 acres recorded in Khatian No. 636 of Mouza Mijmahichail, claiming 5 annas 16 gondas 2 karas and 2 kranti share in the suit property and claimed partition of her share. Her case is inter alia that the suit property belonged to Maharam Ali, father of plaintiff and defendant No. 1 ; out of the tenancy Maharam Ali sold away Plot No. 718 with an area of 0.68 acre. Maharam Ali died leaving behind a widow Senorama, two daughters Chena Bibi, the plaintiff, and Hezara Bibi the defendant No. 1 and a brother, Akbar Ali. Senorama died leaving two daughters, namely, plaintiff and defendant No. 1 and a son Munsar Ali by former husband. Defendant Nos. 2-7 are the heirs of Munsur Ali and defendant No. 10 is the heir of Akbar Ali. As her demand for partition was refused she has filed the suit.
